title: Reading Drill — Comparing reusable coffee filters — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing reusable coffee filters — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The coffee stall operator had been asked to investigate filters losing their shape after repeated rinsing in Foxhaven. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on changes in filter diameter, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a five-week comparison, the team used shape templates at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because wear from stirring might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a different drying position. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
